authorization: Within user-requested final-model evaluation alignment; assistant identified label-homogeneous original query batches, asked optional preference, and stated proceeding with recommended mixed-batch diagnostic while retaining originals
purpose: Separate final-model performance from label-homogeneous query-batch composition
training: No retraining; saved small and 100k model states
query_order: numpy default_rng(43).permutation of all test row indices, independent of features and labels
pfn: Recompute every test probability in mixed query order; scatter predictions and probabilities back to original row IDs
distpfn: Use only the current mixed query batch for posterior correction; also compute original-group counterfactual from the identical saved probabilities
static_models: XGB, proposed model and BoostPFN are row-wise predictors without batch posterior correction; verify on an 8192-row mixed query audit and reuse saved full predictions if exact, otherwise rerun complete mixed-order inference
budget_audit: Audit no-FT PFN predictions at budgets 10/20/50/200/400 under the same mixed query order; XGB is row-wise
scope: Small final comparison and large natural/uniform final comparison; no test-driven tuning
